title: MZ RMMZ Dev Tools — VS Code Extension for MZ Plugin Development (14 free features)

posts.author: y1uda
posts.body:
Hi everyone,
I built a VS Code extension specifically for RPG Maker MZ plugin developers. There's been almost no dedicated tooling for MZ plugin development — existing extensions are either abandoned, MV-only, or just snippets. So I made one that covers the full workflow.
14 features are completely free:
Annotation syntax highlighting (
/*:
,
/*:ja
,
/*~struct~
blocks)
Smart
@tag
and
@type
completion (context-aware — knows which tags are valid where)
Real-time validation — catches typos like
@commnd
, invalid types, scope violations, missing
@plugindesc
Hover documentation for every annotation tag and type
Annotation formatter (reorders tags in canonical order)
Inline color picker for hex colors in
@default
Plugin conflict detection — static analysis finds multiple plugins overriding the same method, with CodeLens warnings
Asset reference checker (
@dir
/
@require
validated against your project files)
One-click IntelliSense setup — generates
jsconfig.json
so you get autocomplete for
$gameParty
,
Window_Base
, etc.
Plugin template generator
Quick actions sidebar panel
Database browser (Actors, Items, Weapons, etc. in a tree view)
Note tag index (scans all
data/*.json
)
Pro features ($12 one-time, no subscription):
The big one is testplay integration — one-click debugger setup (F5 to launch, breakpoints, step through your plugin code, edit variables like
$gameParty._gold
directly in VS Code's Variables panel). Also: quick scene reload without restarting from title, live game preview, console capture, game state inspector, dependency graph, parameter rename refactoring, multi-language sync, data hover, formula evaluator, and more.
